integrity: All numerical statements in the finding are replayed from the embedded facet list by a standalone exact checker; literature claims are limited to inspected source material.
limitations: Specific to the fixed triangulation L(3,1)_12 and coefficients in F_3.
No claim is made about all triangulations of the lens space or about other coefficient fields.
An unindexed historical computation of the same finite cohomology coset cannot be ruled out.
scientific: Exact finite cohomological cosystole computation for the published 12-vertex simplicial triangulation of L(3,1).
title: Exact mod-three one-cosystole of the twelve-vertex lens space
